title: Delivery failure report
sample:
Generating server: mail.example.test
room@example.test
Remote server returned: 550 5.1.10 Recipient not found
note: The notice names the failed address and gives an error. Match it to the trace.
heading: Example from Microsoft documentation, not tenant data

title: DNS mail check
sample:
TXT name: sender.example.test
TXT value: v=spf1 ip4:192.0.2.24 -all
note: Read the practice sender address alongside the SPF record.
heading: Example from Microsoft documentation, not tenant data

title: Authentication-Results header
sample: Authentication-Results: spf=fail smtp.mailfrom=sender.example.test; dkim=pass header.d=sender.example.test; dmarc=pass header.from=sender.example.test
note: Read each stamp on its own. The sample domains and verdicts are made up.
heading: Example from Microsoft documentation, not tenant data

title: Mail flow rule
sample:
SubjectContainsWords: invoice
SentTo: desk@example.test
note: These are practice values for two rule conditions. Check both conditions against the same message.
heading: Example from Microsoft documentation, not tenant data
